raw_site_text: The study involved 15 countries (Appendix A) and contacting over 10,000 male clubs.
justification: Amateur football clubs in each country were contacted by email/social media from public contact lists; no sub-national places are named in the text.
note: Genuine study country (assignment stratified by country). Clubs' locations not stated; sub-national data used only for heterogeneity (Appendix H). Not explicitly described as national.
